success.description: Doktor Festus injects his foul-smelling poisons into the subject of his experiment. Each time a recharge token is removed from this action, the target suffers 1 fatigue.
As above, and when this action recharges, the target must make a Disease check with a difficulty equal to the amount of fatigue he suffered during this action.

boon.description: The target gains a temporary insanity with the Chaos or Trauma trait. Each time a recharge token is removed from this action, add a tracking token to this insanity.

conservative.requirements: Used By: Doktor Festus Engaged with target Special: Reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc} if the target is securely restrained. This action completely recharges as soon as Doktor Festus disengages from the target, makes an attack, or uses an Active Defence.
conservative.name: Dark Experiment

success.description: You inject your foul-smelling poisons into the subject of your experiment. Each time a recharge token is removed from this action, the target suffers 1 fatigue.
As above, and when this action recharges, the target must make a Resilience check with a difficulty equal to the amount of fatigue he suffered during this action to resist corruption.

boon.description: The target gains a temporary insanity with the Chaos or Trauma trait. Each time a recharge token is removed from this action, add a tracking token to this insanity.

bane.description: Add a tracking token to this insanity.

reckless.requirements: Engaged with target. You must have a variety of depraved tools at hand. Special: Reduce the difficulty modifier by {Dc} if the target is securely restrained. This action completely recharges as soon as you disengage from the target, make an attack, or use an Active Defence.
reckless.name: Dark Experiment
